FIELDS.NAME: Creative Corner Crafts
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Sarah Johnson, Compliance Manager, 123 Craft Lane, Springfield, IL 62701-4567, (555) 123-4567, sarah.johnson@creativecornercrafts.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Creative Corner Crafts is a retail craft and hobby store located in Springfield, IL that specializes in providing a wide range of art supplies, craft materials, and hobby tools for both beginners and experienced crafters. Our store offers a welcoming environment where customers can explore various products, including painting supplies, scrapbook materials, yarn, and DIY kits. 

We pride ourselves on hosting instructional workshops and classes that promote creativity and skill development, all of which are covered by appropriate professional liability insurance. Customer safety is paramount; therefore, we maintain a clean and well-organized store with clear aisles, proper lighting, and regularly inspected premises to comply with local fire and safety codes.

To enhance our operational efficacy, we have implemented robust inventory control systems that include regular stock audits to prevent theft and ensure product availability. Our dedicated staff undergoes training on safe handling of tools and materials, significantly minimizing workplace risks associated with craft activities. 

Overall, Creative Corner Crafts is committed to fostering a safe, creative, and enjoyable shopping experience for our community.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the sales or rentals of hazardous materials exceeding minimal, consumer-safe quantities and confirms that it maintains a clean safety record with no recent claims related to customer or employee injuries. Our premises are well-maintained, featuring clear aisles, proper lighting, and no visible hazards, and we strictly adhere to all local fire and safety codes, including up-to-date permits and regular inspections.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 15, 2023, we experienced a minor theft incident where craft supplies valued at $150 were stolen. The loss was reported to the local authorities, and we have since enhanced our security measures, including installing additional surveillance cameras. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Sunday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Retail Safe, Class II, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System with 24/7 monitoring and on-site security personnel during business hours.
